title: ungrammatical sentences the parser must refuse
description: harness/negatives.json: each entry is an ungrammatical English sentence (every token in the lexicon) with a grammatical control. The negatives action asserts that the rule parser accepts every control and that both parser implementations refuse every sentence; a sentence with an unknown token is an error, since refusing it would prove nothing.

sentence.description: lowercased corpus tokenization, tokens separated by single spaces, ending in . ? or !

control.description: lowercased corpus tokenization, tokens separated by single spaces, ending in . ? or !

adapted.description: true when the sentence is not the published form verbatim
